newsitem.title: NICARAGUA: Nicaragua takes second try at telephone sale.
newsitem.headline: Nicaragua takes second try at telephone sale.

text.p: Nicaragua on Thursday will again try to sell part of its state telephone company Enitel, an official said.

The first attempt to sell 40 percent of Empresa Nicaraguense de Telecomunicaciones SA was canceled on July 27 because bidders had asked for more time to study the company, telephone officials said at the time.
But the first postponement, other delays and a lack of information regarding the sale have created more doubts as to whether or not Thursday's privatization will take place.

"I think the probability of the sale taking place is 95 percent to five percent in its favor. Something very important would have to take place for it to be postponed again," Jaime Bonilla, the secretary general of Nicaragua's National Assembly, told Reuters on Wednesday.

Enitel spokesman Orlando Barrera said investors qualified to place bids include AT&T, Korea Telecom, Sprint International, GTE International, STET International of Italy, France Telecom, CTT of Chile and Spain's Telefonica Internacional.
